# Work in R

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_pathways.py from data/pathways.yml. Do not edit this file: change the data and run the script. -->

Load the practice data in MESA RStudio Geospatial and check its flags.

**The essentials: 2 tutorials, 10 to 15 minutes in all.** Take them in order, or start wherever your question is. Nothing is locked. Each point also lists what to take if you have more time.

New to the portal? Take [New to MESA](new-to-mesa.md) first.

!!! warning "These tutorials are drafts"
    Each tutorial says at the top how far it has been checked.

## Run and understand

*Understand data.* You can say what a dataset holds and where it is incomplete or doubtful, before you compute with it.

1. [Load a file from your Data Store in RStudio](../tutorials/r-load-a-file.md) (5 to 10 minutes)
2. [Tally a quality flag in R](../tutorials/r-tally-a-quality-flag.md) (5 minutes)

If you have more time:

- [Map point data with sf in MESA RStudio Geospatial](../tutorials/map-points-in-rstudio.md) (10 minutes)

## Query and connect

You can ask questions across files and tables, and show that combining them did what you meant.

If you have more time:

- [Query a Parquet file with DuckDB from R](../tutorials/r-query-parquet-with-duckdb.md) (10 minutes)
